title: fix Detect diagram fallback
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Removes `flowchart` as fallback for detectDiagram and throw error if diagram is not recognised.

Resolves #3391 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Will avoid ambiguity and wrong errors being thrown when flowchart is used.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added unit/e2e tests (if appropriate)
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
@knsv I've removed detectors and connect diagram for now as we're currently using lazyLoadedDiagrams.
We can introduce it later once we have nailed down the interface completely.
